description: Pre-inference paired support-retrieval scoring plan for the small additional human-review challenge; no human labels supplied or model change approved.
global_quality_gate: Answerable macro metrics do not regress; group Recall@3 loss at most0.05. Coverage minima required; no significance/general quality/adoption inference.
absent_answer_policy: All support-retrieval metrics null; exclude from answerable macro averages. Record separately; ranking-only comparison does not certify calibrated abstention.
candidate_policy: Same baseline candidate set, maximum10 source-revalidated points per query, with deterministic existing trial point-ID tie break. New challenge8 sources means an at-most8-point diagnostic pool, not large-corpus retrieval.
execution_policy: Three actual paired repetitions with approved embedding and exact original Qwen reranker batch4 contract, fixed owner-scoped sources and retained source/hash/provenance verification; no replay of model scores between repetitions. Require separate actual execution evidence.

bootstrap.meaning: Descriptive query-bootstrap95 percentiles; eight authored cases cannot establish representative independent sampling.
